diagnostics.title: Webhook log exporter disabled (its target was refused)
diagnostics.summary: The host refused the webhook exporter's target URL when the exporter opened, so the exporter is disabled and its request logs are NOT delivered. This is a configuration problem surfaced at open, not a transient delivery failure.
diagnostics.action: Fix the named webhook exporter's `url` (a destination the host's egress policy admits) and reload the configuration; the reload re-enables delivery.

diagnostics.title: Webhook log delivery returned non-2xx (log dropped)
diagnostics.summary: A request-log webhook delivery got a non-2xx response from the sink, so that one log line was dropped (deliveries are fire-and-forget and never retried). It is warned on every dropped line, as 1.5.5 warned it: an unhealthy sink is the operator's to fix.
diagnostics.action: If logs are being lost, check the webhook sink's health: each dropped line is its own warn line. `busbar_webhook_logs_dropped_total` counts only lines shed by the in-flight bound, not failed deliveries.

diagnostics.title: Webhook log delivery transport error (log dropped)
diagnostics.summary: A request-log webhook delivery failed with a transport error (connection/timeout/DNS), so that one log line was dropped. Deliveries are fire-and-forget and never retried. It is warned on every dropped line, as 1.5.5 warned it: an unreachable sink is the operator's to fix.
diagnostics.action: If logs are being lost, check the webhook sink's reachability: each dropped line is its own warn line. `busbar_webhook_logs_dropped_total` counts only lines shed by the in-flight bound, not failed deliveries.

diagnostics.title: Webhook log batch cut short by a settings reload (logs dropped)
diagnostics.summary: A request-log webhook delivery was in flight when the exporter's settings were reloaded. The line in flight finished on the settings it started under; the batch's remaining lines were dropped rather than sent with the old settings' credentials to the new target, or with the new ones on a batch begun elsewhere. Warned once per cut batch, with the count dropped.
diagnostics.action: Expected around a reload of the named webhook exporter; if it recurs without reloads, check what is reloading the configuration.
